mapper.select: SELECT rule_id AS "ruleId", rule_name AS "ruleName", target_table AS "targetTable", rule_type AS "ruleType", check_sql AS "checkSql", severity AS "severity", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM pmc_dq_rule ORDER BY rule_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_dq_result(rule_id, violation_count, status) VALUES(#{ruleId}, #{violationCount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT r.result_id AS "resultId", r.rule_id AS "ruleId", u.rule_name AS "ruleName", u.severity AS "severity", r.violation_count AS "violationCount", r.status AS "status", to_char(r.checked_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "checkedAt" FROM pmc_dq_result r JOIN pmc_dq_rule u ON u.rule_id=r.rule_id ORDER BY r.result_id DESC LIMIT 100
